lines.zh: 我落在你肩上，爪子很轻。
lines.en: I settle on your shoulder, claws light.
I follow you at a low height.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收着，走起来有点笨。
lines.en: Wings folded, I walk a little clumsily.
I hop along behind you.
I ruffle my feathers.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶掠过，落回原处。
lines.en: I sweep over your head and land again.
I glide a short way above the ground.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你肩上换了个扣。
lines.en: My talons shift their grip on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上有影子。
lines.en: My claws cast a shadow on the ground.
I stop at your feet and wait.

lines.zh: 我落在你身后的枝上跟着。
lines.en: I flit from branch to branch behind you.
I fold and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 驯服的血鹰，爪踩你的脚印。
lines.en: A tamed blood eagle's talons on your prints.

lines.zh: 我落在你前面的路上等你。
lines.en: I land ahead on the path and wait.
I stand on your shoulder.
My feathers are dark red.
I tuck my head into my wing.
I watch for movement far off.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓紧你的衣领。
lines.en: My claws grip your collar.
I preen my breast slowly.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一声低哑的啼。
lines.en: A low, hoarse cry rolls from my throat.
I listen to what the wind carries.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀张了一下，又收好。
lines.en: I half-open my wings and fold them.
My eyes are bright.
I lean against your neck.
I shift my claws to another grip.
I know your shoulder.
Where are you looking?
I will watch your left.
You may stroke my back.
I won't bite these hands.
I land so you can see me.
Speak and I answer.
I rest my head by your ear.

lines.zh: 我的爪子不会抓破你的衣服。
lines.en: My claws won't tear your clothes.
I stay with you, never far.
Your shoulder is warm.
I look into your eyes.
Your left is clear; I'm watching it.

lines.zh: 我收翅的时候没有声音。
lines.en: I fold my wings without a sound.

lines.zh: 你摸我的胸口，那里很热。
lines.en: Touch my breast; it is warm.
I tuck my beak into my feathers.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛是干血的颜色。
lines.en: My feathers are the color of dried blood.
I need no leash.
A few feathers are out of place.
I hop aside.
One wing is knocked crooked.
I drop to the ground.
Dark red feathers fall to the dirt.
I ruffle my feathers and settle.
Crooked wing or not, I fly.
I spread my wings again.
I lean against your feet.
I push up onto my legs.
That in your palm — for me?
Raise it and I'll come down.
Flatten your palm and I'll take it.
My beak is careful.
I finish it in one bite.
Any more in your sleeve?
I don't eat much.
Don't pull your hand back. I'm not done.
I like that taste.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我飞起来一点。
lines.en: You bump me and I lift off a bit.
I am light; I'm no burden.
Don't wave; it startles me.

lines.zh: 我从你肩头跳到另一边。
lines.en: I hop from one shoulder to the other.
My fault; I wasn't watching.
I spread my wings to steady.
Your hand touched my tail.
I retreat to the beam.
I settle back on your shoulder.
I am yours; nothing else is needed.
My kind live alongside people.
I gently nip your ear.
I press my head to your cheek.
I will not leave this yard.
I follow only one in my life.
Don't set me down.
I fold my wings and come close.

lines.zh: 你站着，我落在肩上，就好。
lines.en: You stand; I perch. That's enough.
I pick it up and fly up.
My claws can hold this.
Too heavy; I let go midair.
I place it in your hand.

lines.zh: 从上面看，什么掉都逃不过。
lines.en: From up here nothing falls unseen.
I carry it back.
I brought this back for you.
I let go and it lands at your feet.
I'll go. You wait.
Point, and I go.
My wings are already spread.
I'll go down first and look.
Stay here.
I call once, and you will know.
It is behind us.
I'll circle above.
I'll hold it; you come.

lines.zh: 翅膀已经压成俯冲的角度。
lines.en: My wings are set for a dive.
I see it.
It is hiding behind the tree.
I'll take the high way.
Its smell has changed.
I circle above.

lines.zh: 它抬头看我，我就降一点。
lines.en: It looks up, and I drop lower.
I fold my wings and drop straight down.
My shadow already covers it.
It is ducking behind a tree.
I called to warn you.
I cut in at its left flank.
It looks at me, not you.
I've picked my angle from above.
At this height it can't reach me.
Now — you go, I press.
I lower my wings and glide in.
It looks up, so I climb.
I wait for it to leave cover.
My claws are above it.
It is retreating toward you.
I call to signal you.
It can't tell the two of us apart.
Both my claws clamp down.
My claws clamp its back.
I peck at its eyes.
I added the dive to that blow.
I lift it by the grip.
I fling it aside.
My wing strikes its face.
I bite its neck.
I let go; you follow up.
I return to your shoulder.
I seize it and pull upward.
My beak strikes its shoulder.
I beat its eyes with my wings.
That carried the dive.
I drop it in front of you.
My claws hold.
I come down from above the canopy.
Your shoulder is here.
My wings are folded.
The wind is good here.
I fold and land on your hand.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛还带着外面的凉。
lines.en: My feathers still carry the outside chill.

lines.zh: 我贴近你的肩膀绕一圈。
lines.en: I circle once at your shoulder.
I give you one short call.
I take my place on your shoulder.
I turn my head your way.
I fold and drop from the sky.
I know your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我顺着你留下的血味找来。
lines.en: I follow the scent of blood you left.
I circled half a turn before finding you.
Wind still clings to my feathers.
I called twice.
I land on your left.
I settle my wings.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的羽毛，我拍打着灭。
lines.en: Fire catches my feathers; I beat it out.
I hit the ground with a folded wing.

lines.zh: 羽毛吸水，我只能在水面上扑。
lines.en: Wet feathers; I can only thrash.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过翅根，羽毛乱了。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my wing's base.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我的羽毛竖起。
lines.en: Violet light raises my feathers.

lines.zh: 雷光里我的羽毛全亮了。
lines.en: In the flash my feathers all lit up.
The wind is gone and I fall.
